test_where_method: test the pandas Series.where method with boolean conditions and replacement values
test_where_unsafe_int: test the pandas Series where and setitem behavior with unsafe integer numpy dtypes
test_where_unsafe_upcast: test the pandas Series where dtype upcast behavior with integer and float numpy dtypes
test_where_inplace: test the pandas Series.where method with inplace=True parameter
test_where_dups: test the pandas Series.where method with duplicate index values
test_where_array_like: test the pandas Series.where method with array-like boolean conditions
test_where_invalid_input: test the pandas Series.where method raises errors on invalid condition inputs
test_where_setitem_invalid: test the pandas Series setitem raises errors on invalid indexer length mismatches
test_where_numeric_with_string: test the pandas Series.where method with numeric series and string replacement values
test_where_sparse: test the pandas Series.where method on sparse array data
